receipt_publication: Documentation added after the tested release; the executable release tag is unchanged.
evaluator_scope: Fresh task context for the initial candidate exercise; the same AI evaluator repeated tasks on the exact release commit. Public documentation, inputs and CLI help were used; private manuscripts, other reviewers' conclusions and implementation internals were not consulted to resolve tasks.
command_convention: Direct executable invocations from retained receipts; original relative paths retained. exercise denotes final_commit/ below exercise_parent and contains source/, .venv/, inputs/, outputs/. Logging and stopwatch wrappers are omitted; no private absolute path is published.

commands.command: .venv/Scripts/python -c "import json; from pathlib import Path; from radpareto import compare,validate_document; from radpareto.units import period_ns_from_mhz; path=Path('source/benchmarks/published_case/results/records.json'); records=validate_document(json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))); result=compare(records,limits={'cells':40,'period_ns':period_ns_from_mhz('32')}); print(json.dumps(result['feasibility']['DF-TMR-DFF-5.12'],indent=2))"

.venv/Scripts/python -c "import csv,json; from decimal import Decimal as D; row=next(r for r in csv.DictReader(open('source/benchmarks/published_case/source_tables.csv',encoding='utf-8')) if r['structure']=='DF-TMR-DFF-5.12'); print(json.dumps({'source_row':row,'selected_requirement_mhz':'32','selected_limit_ns':str(D(1000)/D(32)),'reciprocal_mean_ns':str(D(1000)/D(row['fmax_mean_mhz'])),'reciprocal_lower_ns':str(D(1000)/D(row['fmax_max_mhz'])),'reciprocal_upper_ns':str(D(1000)/D(row['fmax_min_mhz'])),'mean_meets_32':D(row['fmax_mean_mhz'])>=D(32),'range_crosses_32':D(row['fmax_min_mhz'])<D(32)<D(row['fmax_max_mhz'])},indent=2))"

source_identifiers.source_hash_scope: Original transcription bytes, not publisher bytes

Initial installation used the default pip cache. Exact-commit repetition used local temporary/cache directories and --no-cache-dir.
An initial source-row query used design; public header inspection corrected it to structure.
CLI --help supplied batch syntax and established that it has no --limit option.
Explicit output JSON, run manifests and exit-code receipts supplemented incomplete native subprocess capture by PowerShell transcription.
limits: Selected automated public-workflow execution only. Not an independent human participant, hardware reproduction, full synthesis rerun, exhaustive test, publisher-data authentication or proof of all scientific claims. Expected exit-2 refusals are successful diagnostics.
